'''Ardru''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Iseno sector/Legends|Iseno sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

==History==
During the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], investors from Ardru and the nearby planet [[Denon/Legends|Denon]] created the [[Denon-Ardru Mutual]], a powerful [[Mining/Legends|mining]] and refinery corporation known for its tyrannical methods.<ref name="Obi-Wan" />

==Appearances==
*''[[The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' {{1stm}}
